scope: Actual compiled native AI controller and byte-identical adapter in isolated scope/storage

tests.name: current authorized customer archive can read native AI history without contact or business writes
operator cannot see ownerless AI system records or gain access from a same-phone customer
operator has only exact original call ownership, not configuration or audit authorship
a reader module role does not widen an operator data scope while a legitimate tenant reader remains read-only
a verified global administrator retains existing read rights only inside its bound tenant scope
a forged super role or module role without actual platform-administrator authority is rejected
an exact owned task assignment proves access, but same task or phone alone does not
ambiguous, other-tenant and unowned assignments never grant an operator access
explicit other tenant, enterprise or brand is excluded even for current tenant administrator
explicit verified native AI tenant correspondence is allowed, without guessing names
missing module, member grant, archive permission and all native source permissions fail closed
frame account/scope/brand/enterprise mismatches and wrong page cannot read AI profile data
duplicate native identities are not guessed or counted twice, including a foreign-scope collision
equal session numbers from different suppliers remain distinct accurate source records
masked numbers stay pending and never turn into guessed customer keys; exact source detail remains resolvable
malformed phone types and absent source IDs remain explicit issues rather than fabricated records
provider statuses use current native HP and Dazhong mappings rather than generic numeric labels
Dazhong summary and component tags reuse the actual original fetched-detail semantics without media URLs
a fetched provider detail with a foreign tenant, brand or enterprise cannot leak its summary through a local call
fetched detail record IDs and raw phones must match the original source exactly
matching fetched-detail scope and call identity preserve source bytes and original summary semantics
fetched native detail status and zero duration use the same merged values as the original detail view
waiting and filtered records with conflicting positive dial facts stay unknown rather than inflating counts
actual contact time is never replaced by view time, and invalid dates remain unknown
source task and scene IDs are preserved only when explicit, never inferred from names
resolve rechecks exact identity, phone, scope and current permissions before returning only a native reference
scope and role changes after a read invalidate old source references, without exposing another tenant record
a revoked owner between read and resolve is denied even at the same phone and scope
a late source projection after context revocation returns no rows
untrusted copies and a replaced native source cannot be used as an alternative source channel
profile reads do not grant recording playback; original page and F31 guards remain required
unbranded but consistently bound native tenant sources retain original read eligibility
original followup source fills four full-phone customer gaps absent from the actual 37-call source
call and followup source permissions are independent rather than requiring both pages
actual visit detail rows are preserved without using reported visit count as generated facts
a real latest-record/time pair is a summary only and missing values never get demo defaults
explicit empty or malformed visit arrays never turn the platform count into fabricated entries
masked or conflicting call identifiers never repair a followup phone or merge it with another call
followup data scope requires its own owner proof, not an owned call at the same phone
followup native locator is exact and rejects duplicates, foreign scope and missing typed keys
followup references bind content and read rights, so stale results cannot open changed source rows
the original followup profile opens a safe read-only view of actual values without invoking index fallback
source followup open rechecks changed identity, current page, ownership and permissions before any UI write
followup DTOs omit source recording URLs and never manufacture source IDs, actors or formal archive state
